description: This file defines the CalendarAccountEventFactory class responsible for creating instances of CalendarAccountEvent from various data sources like beans for meetings, calls, and tasks. It includes methods for converting these beans into calendar events, handling date parsing, and managing event relationships.

classes.name: CalendarAccountEventFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of CalendarAccountEvent from beans like Meeting, Call, and Task, managing date conversions and event relationship data.

methods.name: fromMeetingBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent object from a Meeting bean and a CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromBean
methods.description: Converts a bean object (Meeting, Call, or Task) into a CalendarAccountEvent, parsing dates, setting event type, and retrieving relationship data.

methods.name: fromCallBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Call bean and CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromTaskBean
methods.description: Creates a CalendarAccountEvent from a Task bean and CalendarAccount.

methods.name: fromSourceEvent
methods.description: Creates a new CalendarAccountEvent based on a source event and a specified event ID.

methods.name: parseDateTimeString
methods.description: Parses a date string into a SugarDateTime object, checking different formats and fallback to user time zone.
